bag_ball_received.semantics: Only success reaches SCF/RET. DE must point at wNumBalls; reject other pockets. Read back pocket contents and quantity rather than assuming a one-item delta.

battle_end.semantics: Entry precedes end-result handling, evolution and cleanup. wBattleResult remains a bitfield; this is not completion or whiteout proof.

battle_faint.semantics: Engine faint handling has selected wCurBattleMon. Battle HP/status copyback has not yet run; snapshot battle and party records separately.

capture_box.semantics: SendMonIntoBox predef has returned on the full-party catch branch, before the box-count full flag check. Final-slot and nonfinal-slot runtime controls remain open.

capture_box_finalized.semantics: This common path also runs after failed/tutorial catches. Only a matched prior successful box insertion may publish final identity; without it this site emits nothing.

capture_party.semantics: Party-count fork selected TryAddMonToParty; its predef has returned. Caught metadata and nickname work remain; retain acquisition until final identity readback.

capture_party_finalized.semantics: This common path also runs after failed/tutorial catches. Only a matched prior successful party insertion may publish final identity; without it this site emits nothing.

change_box_begin.semantics: Box-change attempt; confirmations can still refuse. Retain old-box context.

change_box_loaded.semantics: Confirmations passed, SaveBox returned, wCurBox changed and LoadBox returned. UI/game-logic resumption remains.

contest_box_finalized.semantics: Return shared by success and box-capacity refusal. Publish only with contest_box_inserted latch; never trust BUGCONTEST_BOXED_MON alone. Crystal also writes caught metadata on refusal.

contest_box_inserted.semantics: Capacity refusal bypasses this site. Record success-only insertion latch before nickname/caught metadata; receiver first box record.

contest_party_finalized.semantics: Party copy, OT and nickname finalization complete; Crystal caught location complete. Contest buffer cleared and success published. Receiver PartyCount-1.

contest_selected.semantics: GeneratePartyMonStats completed after first catch or accepted replacement. Decline returns earlier. This is provisional contest buffer, not final party/box capture.

continue_confirmed.semantics: TryLoadSaveFile succeeded and Continue/RTC confirmations passed. Clock/roamer/mobile/map setup remains; no overworld admission.

identity_migration.old_species_witness: unique pre-evolution of the published species (A)

evolution_species_published.semantics: Evolved struct and move work preceded this point; parallel species marker has now been written. wEvolutionOldSpecies retains old species for key migration.

gift_begin.semantics: Record script-gift intent before party/box insertion; failure exit is not acquisition.

gift_box_finalized.semantics: Box nickname copy and CloseSRAM completed before B=1 return. Failures return with B=2; receiver is first box slot.

gift_party_finalized.semantics: RET Z is party success after metadata and optional name work. Require Z and B=0; failures return separately with B=2.

hatch_finalized.semantics: The next-slot path is shared with unhatched/non-egg skips. Publish gift_daycare only with matching hatch_species latch for current wCurPartyMon; OT/HP/name work completed on that matched path.

hatch_species.semantics: The parallel party species entry has replaced EGG. HP, OT identity and naming still change later; publication must be deferred.

link_trade_received.semantics: Incoming party copy and forced evolution follow. Intermediate transaction marker only, not completed trade or durability. Only LINK_TRADECENTER is admitted by this candidate guard; Time Capsule and mobile modes are excluded.

link_trade_saved.semantics: SaveAfterLinkTrade returned after AddTempmonToParty and forced evolution. Receiver is appended party slot. Host scenario save and cold reload remain required for durability. Only LINK_TRADECENTER is admitted by this candidate guard; Time Capsule and mobile modes are excluded.

map_entry_complete.semantics: RunMapSetupScript returned, entry method cleared, MAPSTATUS_HANDLE published. No write-checkpoint authority.

new_game.semantics: New-game entry precedes ResetWRAM and campaign initialization; it is not an admitted live-session boundary.

npc_trade_begin.semantics: Snapshot selected outgoing party identity before removal and append.

npc_trade_finalized.semantics: Name, OT, DVs, OT ID, item and stats are complete. Receiver is PARTY_COUNT_MINUS_ONE; restored wCurPartyMon is the outgoing selection and must not select the receiver.

pc_deposit_begin.semantics: Snapshot selected identity before transfer; full-box/full-party failure must clear the attempt without publication.

pc_deposit_complete.semantics: The carry failure branch was bypassed and removal returned. Consume the prior identity; slot positions may have compacted.

pc_release_box_begin.semantics: Release checks and accepted YesNo precede this call. Snapshot the outgoing record before compaction.

pc_release_box_complete.semantics: Removal returned; consume the prior outgoing identity instead of reading its compacted former slot.

pc_release_party_begin.semantics: Release checks and accepted YesNo precede this call. Snapshot the outgoing record before compaction.

pc_release_party_complete.semantics: Removal returned; consume the prior outgoing identity instead of reading its compacted former slot.

pc_withdraw_begin.semantics: Snapshot selected identity before transfer; full-box/full-party failure must clear the attempt without publication.

pc_withdraw_complete.semantics: The carry failure branch was bypassed and removal returned. Consume the prior identity; slot positions may have compacted.

poison_faint.semantics: This branch follows one HP of poison damage and a zero HP result. Status reset follows; wCurPartyMon identifies the affected slot.

roamer_box_finalized.semantics: Common return requires BATTLETYPE_ROAMING plus a same-operation successful box insertion latch. Failed catches and ordinary/fixed Suicune encounters are excluded. Final key/species drives legend_<species> policy only after independent readback. This row classifies the same acquisition and must not emit a second capture or consume the latch twice.

roamer_party_finalized.semantics: Common return requires BATTLETYPE_ROAMING plus a same-operation successful party insertion latch. Failed catches and ordinary/fixed Suicune encounters are excluded. Final key/species drives legend_<species> policy only after independent readback. This row classifies the same acquisition and must not emit a second capture or consume the latch twice.

save_completed.semantics: All _SaveGameData calls have returned at this terminal RET. It is a CPU completion candidate, not CartRAM durability or recovery proof.

script_wild_staged.semantics: CPU interpreter handler has consumed scripted wild species/level and set battle-script flags. This is origin staging, not catch completion; per-story static policy must join a later success-only capture.

soft_reset.semantics: Reset entry invalidates observations; subsequent Init also has cold-start callers. This is not a new-game classifier.

trainer_ready.semantics: ReadTrainerParty and trainer-mode assignment precede the return. No claim that a runtime hook has fired.

stack_words_equals.meaning: Script_special farcall return after saved AF word

whiteout_before_heal.semantics: CPU Special dispatch runs before HealParty. Every generated DE, script-bank, script-position and two-level CPU return-stack guard is mandatory; ordinary heals must not be treated as whiteout.

wild_ready.semantics: LoadEnemyMon and wild move/PP staging precede this local label; presentation work remains. Source candidate only.
